title: 三种 JOIN 算法代价对比与排序
expected_output:
驱动表 N = 1000, 被驱动表 M = 100000

算法                                   代价(次操作)          相对最优
无索引嵌套循环 simple nested loop           100000000        x1960.8
索引嵌套循环 index nested loop             51000            x1.0
哈希连接 hash join                       101000           x2.0
排序归并 sort-merge join                 1771930          x34.7

代价排序(由低到高):
  1. 索引嵌套循环 index nested loop           51000
  2. 哈希连接 hash join                     101000
  3. 排序归并 sort-merge join               1771930
  4. 无索引嵌套循环 simple nested loop         100000000

结论: 最优 = 索引嵌套循环 index nested loop
      最差 = 无索引嵌套循环 simple nested loop (被驱动表没索引时的经典陷阱)
      差倍率 = 1961 倍
code:
import math

N = 1000          # 驱动表行数
M = 100000        # 被驱动表行数
IDX_COST = 3      # 一次索引查找的「页访问」折算代价

def simple_nl():      # 无索引嵌套循环
    return N * M

def index_nl():       # 有索引: 外层每行做一次索引查找
    depth = math.ceil(math.log2(M))
    return N * depth * IDX_COST

def hash_join():      # 小表建哈希, 大表探测一遍
    return N + M

def sort_merge():     # 两侧排序 + 归并
    return (N * math.log2(N) + M * math.log2(M)) + N + M

algos = [
    ("无索引嵌套循环 simple nested loop", simple_nl()),
    ("索引嵌套循环 index nested loop",   index_nl()),
    ("哈希连接 hash join",               hash_join()),
    ("排序归并 sort-merge join",         sort_merge()),
]

print("驱动表 N = %d, 被驱动表 M = %d" % (N, M))
print()
print("%-36s %-16s %s" % ("算法", "代价(次操作)", "相对最优"))
best = min(c for _, c in algos)
for name, cost in algos:
    print("%-36s %-16.0f x%.1f" % (name, cost, cost / best))
print()
ranked = sorted(algos, key=lambda x: x[1])
print("代价排序(由低到高):")
for i, (name, cost) in enumerate(ranked, 1):
    print("  %d. %-34s %.0f" % (i, name, cost))
print()
print("结论: 最优 = %s" % ranked[0][0])
print("      最差 = %s (被驱动表没索引时的经典陷阱)" % ranked[-1][0])
print("      差倍率 = %.0f 倍" % (ranked[-1][1] / ranked[0][1]))
